protocol.novelty_boundary: Prior work covers composition interference, spectral shift and patch/tokenization effects; this is a controlled comparative generalization diagnostic, not a new aliasing mechanism
protocol.candidate_gate: No further expansion without root review
protocol.scope: forecast-only discovery screen; exact q concerns conditional non-tie majority, not mean superiority; no hidden-feature cause or aliasing diagnosis
protocol.time_origin: context t=-C..-1, future t=0..H-1; identical future across contexts
protocol.normalization: native mean/scale recorded, never frozen; empirical context statistics separately labeled
protocol.units: Every pure/mixed/background MSE uses common theoretical (a²+b²)/2, not realized finite-window variance; derivative energy uses b²/2
protocol.comparator_scope: S uses oracle-separated component inputs and three native calls; not a deployable repair. G includes all native computation and input-dependent normalization, not specifically hidden interactions
protocol.role: fresh replication of the preselected crossover; both contexts globally corrected;512 cannot rescue128
protocol.composition: G=L-S where S uses actual f(pure_phi)+f(pure_psi)-f(background); C=G_timesfm-G_bolt
protocol.legacy_interaction: mixed-minus-average-pure J is descriptive only; separable frequency error can produce J!=0 at G=0
protocol.ratio: sum of per-seed normalized S divided by sum of per-seed normalized L; paired whole-seed bootstrap, pointwise
protocol.ranking_flip: requires passing g32>0,g40<0 AND g40-g32<0 at128;512 sensitivity does not rescue
protocol.nonadditivity: positive passing G establishes a diagnostic error reduction; nonsignificant G does not establish absence
